title: Exchangeable preparation and invariant payoff cancel the first-order term
statement: Source-derived conditional theorem:let Q0 be finite-group average of CTMC generator Q,B lift orbit payoffs,H uniformly average within orbits,HB=I,Q0B=BR,HQ0=RH,E=Q-Q0. Require ||E||_infinity<=2eta and ||EBg||_infinity<=eta for all macro payoffs0<=g<=1;the exact group average gives HEB=0. For initial mu=mu_bar H and every terminal orbit-invariant0<=f<=1,the payoff discrepancy |mu exp(TQ)Bf-mu_bar exp(TR)f|<=min(1,eta^2 T^2). The report supplies a deterministic Duhamel/projection proof,not a mixing/asymptotic argument or novelty claim. Conservative eta is the sum of absolute native unary and pair coefficient deviations from group averages. For externally scheduled group-equivariant rates replace eta*T by integral eta(t)dt;count-dependent Markov feedback requires invariant observations/actions and augmented controller memory. Individual-label policies are outside this extension. Both preparation and output restrictions are essential:source minimal n2 examples with mean recovery.30 and deviations+/-.001 have discrepancy.00074045 versus wrongly applied quadratic bound.000004 when either start is nonexchangeable or output names a site. Reported3 exact intertwining checks,36 seeded near-lumping tests(max error/bound~.0717),q3 diffuse test(error5.29e-7 vs1.4161e-4) and15 invariant feedback cases(max error~6.36e-7 vs1.871424e-4) are finite synthetic corroboration,not Capital replay or proof of historical originality. Long eta*T makes the bound vacuous;retained group count can remain exponential.

requires: Finite CTMC with known nonnegative unary/pair local rate arrays and supplied scientific transition grammar. Learner and ordinary comparator receive and may retain the same arrays;group labels are withheld from the learner.

Quadratic approximation:initial law uniform within each occupied retained orbit,terminal payoff count invariant and in[0,1],explicit native deviation norms. Intervention schedules or augmented Markov feedback must be group equivariant.
